subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw wait for a captured failed proxy request/response before choosing between diagnostics, another targeted sanitizer, docs, or a strict-minimal compatibility/config mode for OpenAI-compatible completions proxies?
rationale: Current source and prior comments show partial hardening but not the remaining incompatible request feature; adding a new strict-minimal mode or config knob without that artifact would be a product compatibility choice rather than a bounded bug fix.

options.title: Capture first, then choose a narrow fix
options.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted current-main request/response capture, then land only the sanitizer, diagnostic, docs, or explicit mode that the capture proves necessary.

options.title: Add a strict-minimal mode now
options.body: Introduce a new proxy compatibility/config surface before the failing field is known, accepting extra product and upgrade surface to unblock narrower proxies sooner.

options.title: Treat partial hardening as enough
options.body: Defer further core work unless the reporter reproduces the fallthrough on current main with a concrete request/response artifact.

recommendation.title: Capture first, then choose a narrow fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted current-main request/response capture, then land only the sanitizer, diagnostic, docs, or explicit mode that the capture proves necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee for this issue and is therefore the best available owner for the product/triage decision.
